text:
Alex: Heads up — trying to land PR #10432 (reduce kv-cache mem) before the weekend freeze. CI is queued and I'm getting timeouts on the integrations job. Anyone able to review/approve quickly or nudge CI? /cc @Jamie @Priya
Jamie: I can take a quick pass now. fyi CI queue is long: DeployBot reported 18 jobs ahead. If it's flaky we might need a rerun instead of rebase.
DeployBot: CI queue length: 18. Expected start for new job ~ 36m. Last run for PR #10432: integrations failed (timeout). Logs:
```
+ pytest tests/integration/test_cache.py::test_kv_eviction -k slow
Timeout after 30m
```
Priya: Thanks Alex. I reviewed the code — looks fine for me, left 1 small comment. If Jamie and Matt +1 we can put a hold and request a backfill slot.
Matt: I'm +1 on code. Can we trigger a targeted rerun of the failing integration? `./scripts/ci rerun --job integrations --pr 10432` should do it. If it still times out we might need to request a rebase window with infra.
Jamie: Running a local repro now. If it's a flaky infra issue, infra can prioritize a re-run slot in the 2pm PT rebase window. @infra-team can you help if needed? :pray:
Alex: Deploy freeze starts Friday 17:00 PT. If we don't get green before 16:00 PT can we defer to next window without further churn? I don't want to force a late merge during freeze.
Priya: Agreed. If rerun doesn't pass by 15:30 PT I'll mark the PR to wait for next merge window.
Jamie: local repro completed — timeout on long-lived docker pull step, probably network flake. Rerunning with `--no-cache` now.
DeployBot: Rerun queued for PR #10432 (integrations). Estimated start 12m. CI agent: gpu-runner-9.
Matt: If rerun passes, @release-coordinator can we slot it into a quick canary? small risk.
Alex: Sounds good. Thanks all. I'll watch CI and update the PR. :slightly_smiling_face:
